2) Dietary restrictions and any mobility/accessibility notes.
3) Hotel preference or any loyalty program needs (we can block rooms at the Grand Harbor if that works).
4) Ground transport — will NovaPros arrange cars or would you like Redwood to provide car service from the airport?
5) Secure network check — can we schedule a short connectivity test on May 21 at 16:00 local? We’ll bring a laptop with the client VPN config and a test dataset.
6) Any pre-read materials you want on the agenda (we’ll share the draft agenda and a checklist).

Attachments: draft_agenda_v1.pdf (workshop flow) ; redwood_workshop_checklist.xlsx (ops checklist).

If you can send the travel manifest by EOD Monday (May 14), we’ll lock rooms and run the AV/test scheduling. Thanks — cc’ing Aditya and Jonas for any follow-ups on logistics and AV.

Best,
